title: The Last Wages
summary: The Cold Seam closed on a Friday, and its last shift was never paid. The wages are still in the pay office's strongboxes. Old Brannagh wants them out.

steps.journal: Open two chests anywhere in the Cold Seam, on any floor. The pay office, behind its grille on the first floor, holds two.

objectives.label: Chests opened in the Cold Seam

ready: The Cold Seam's last wages, forty years late. Take them to Old Brannagh.
done: Brannagh paid out the last shift's wages to whoever was left, and to their children.
